```{r loading, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Load data 
load("timeseries_NEWDATA.RData")
load("timeseries_OLDDATA.RData")
load("TSvectors_NEWDATA.RData")
load("TSvectors_OLDDATA.RData")


# Load packages
if (!require(forecast)) {install.packages("forecast", dependencies = TRUE); require(forecast)}
if (!require(tseries)) {install.packages("tseries", dependencies = TRUE); require(tseries)}


```


```{r codeOverallImplicitchange, include=FALSE}
## IMPLICIT ATTITUDES --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Combine all data
race.WtsALL <- ts(c(race.Wts, race.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
age.WtsALL <- ts(c(age.Wts, age.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
dis.WtsALL <- ts(c(dis.Wts, dis.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
skin.WtsALL <- ts(c(skin.Wts, skin.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
sex.WtsALL <- ts(c(sex.Wts, sex.WtsNEW), start = c(2007, 1), frequency = 12)
weight.WtsALL <- ts(c(weight.Wts, weight.WtsNEW), start = c(2010, 4), frequency = 12)

## RACE ---------------
# fit model from Charlesworth & Banaji (2019, Psych Science). Parameters were (1,1,1)(2,0,0)
race.arima <- auto.arima(race.Wts, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.race <- forecast(race.arima, h = 48)
decomp.race <- decompose(race.Wts)
race.acc.MASE <- accuracy(forecast.race, race.WtsNEW)["Test set","MASE"]
race.acc.MAPE <- accuracy(forecast.race, race.WtsNEW)["Test set","MAPE"]
race.acc.MAE <- accuracy(forecast.race, race.WtsNEW)["Test set","MAE"]
race.acc.RMSE <- accuracy(forecast.race, race.WtsNEW)["Test set","RMSE"]

# additional accuracy checks: percent of months in the forecast CIs
forecast.raceCI <- as.data.frame(cbind(forecast.race$lower, forecast.race$upper, 
                                       forecast.race$mean, race.WtsNEW))
colnames(forecast.raceCI) <- c("low80", "low95", "upp80", "upp95", "meanfor", "meanobs")

forecast.raceCI$in80 <- ifelse(forecast.raceCI$meanobs < forecast.raceCI$upp80 & forecast.raceCI$meanobs > forecast.raceCI$low80, "inside", "outside")
forecast.raceCI$in95 <- ifelse(forecast.raceCI$meanobs < forecast.raceCI$upp95 & forecast.raceCI$meanobs > forecast.raceCI$low95, "inside", "outside")
race.Nin80 <- as.numeric(table(forecast.raceCI$in80))[1]
race.Nin95 <- as.numeric(table(forecast.raceCI$in95))[1]


# fit model to ALL data (combined)
race.arimaALL <- auto.arima(race.WtsALL, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.raceALL <- forecast(race.arimaALL, h = 60)
forecast.raceALLLONG <- forecast(race.arimaALL, h = 2400) 
minbound.raceALL <- min(which(forecast.raceALLLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
meanbound.raceALL <- min(which(forecast.raceALLLONG$mean<=0))/12 
maxbound.raceALL <- min(which(forecast.raceALLLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WtsALL[1]))/12 
decomp.raceALL <- decompose(race.WtsALL)
start.raceALL <- decomp.raceALL$trend[7]
end.raceALL <- decomp.raceALL$trend[162]
pch.raceALL <- (decomp.raceALL$trend[7] - decomp.raceALL$trend[162])/decomp.raceALL$trend[7] 
rch.raceALL <- decomp.raceALL$trend[7] - decomp.raceALL$trend[162] 

# fit model to NEW data (only recent)
race.arimaNEW <- auto.arima(race.WtsNEW, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.raceNEW <- forecast(race.arimaNEW, h = 60)
forecast.raceNEWLONG <- forecast(race.arimaNEW, h = 2400) 
minbound.raceNEW <- min(which(forecast.raceNEWLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
meanbound.raceNEW <- min(which(forecast.raceNEWLONG$mean<=0))/12 
maxbound.raceNEW <- min(which(forecast.raceNEWLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*race.WtsNEW[1]))/12 
decomp.raceNEW <- decompose(race.WtsNEW)
start.raceNEW <- decomp.raceNEW$trend[7]
end.raceNEW <- decomp.raceNEW$trend[42]
pch.raceNEW <- (decomp.raceNEW$trend[7] - decomp.raceNEW$trend[42])/decomp.raceNEW$trend[7] 
rch.raceNEW <- decomp.raceNEW$trend[7] - decomp.raceNEW$trend[42] 


## AGE -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# fit model from Charlesworth & Banaji (2019, Psych Science). Parameters were (0,1,2)(2,0,0)
age.arima <- auto.arima(age.Wts, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)
forecast.age <- forecast(age.arima, h = 48)
decomp.age <- decompose(age.Wts)
age.acc.MASE <- accuracy(forecast.age, age.WtsNEW)["Test set","MASE"]
age.acc.MAPE <- accuracy(forecast.age, age.WtsNEW)["Test set","MAPE"]
age.acc.MAE <- accuracy(forecast.age, age.WtsNEW)["Test set","MAE"]

# additional accuracy checks: percent of months in the forecast CIs

                                       forecast.age$mean, age.WtsNEW))

forecast.ageCI$in95 <- ifelse(forecast.ageCI$meanobs < forecast.ageCI$upp95 & forecast.ageCI$meanobs > forecast.ageCI$low95, "inside", "outside")

# fit model to ALL data (combined)

forecast.ageALL <- forecast(age.arimaALL, h = 60)
forecast.ageALLLONG <- forecast(age.arimaALL, h = 2400) 
minbound.ageALL <- min(which(forecast.ageALLLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12

maxbound.ageALL <- min(which(forecast.ageALLLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.WtsALL[1]))/12 
decomp.ageALL <- decompose(age.WtsALL)
start.ageALL <- decomp.ageALL$trend[7]
end.ageALL <- decomp.ageALL$trend[162]
pch.ageALL <- (decomp.ageALL$trend[7] - decomp.ageALL$trend[162])/decomp.ageALL$trend[7] 
rch.ageALL <- decomp.ageALL$trend[7] - decomp.ageALL$trend[162] 

# fit model to NEW data (only recent)

forecast.ageNEW <- forecast(age.arimaNEW, h = 60)
forecast.ageNEWLONG <- forecast(age.arimaNEW, h = 2400) 
minbound.ageNEW <- min(which(forecast.ageNEWLONG$lower[,"95%"]<=0))/12 
meanbound.ageNEW <- min(which(forecast.ageNEWLONG$mean<=0))/12 
maxbound.ageNEW <- min(which(forecast.ageNEWLONG$upper[,"95%"]>=2*age.WtsNEW[1]))/12 
decomp.ageNEW <- decompose(age.WtsNEW)
start.ageNEW <- decomp.ageNEW$trend[7]
end.ageNEW <- decomp.ageNEW$trend[42]
pch.ageNEW <- (decomp.ageNEW$trend[7] - decomp.ageNEW$trend[42])/decomp.ageNEW$trend[7] 
rch.ageNEW <- decomp.ageNEW$trend[7] - decomp.ageNEW$trend[42]
```
